CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Painting and Mosaic: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Painting and Mosaic.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Mosaic.
   C. Practise Painting and Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Mosaic.

2. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Wind Musical Instruments.
   B. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   D. Damage equipment used for Wind Musical Instruments.

3. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)

   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

5. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Guarantee a trophy

6. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.

   D. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.

9. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.

10. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   B. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.

11. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Rounders and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Athletics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Fabric Decoration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
